title: How Roger Leer began removing alien implants

tellings.quote: Well, he was a podiatrist and uh he was always interested in UFOs. He was um the most knowledgeable euphologist I've ever met. And um he um was at a UFO conference once and um uh Daryl Sims tried to get him interested in alien implants.

plain: A podiatrist named Roger Leir, a foot doctor with a deep interest in UFOs, is said to have started removing alien implants (small objects some people believe aliens placed in their bodies) after a man named Daryl Sims urged him to look into them at a UFO conference. A scientist named Steve Colbern, who studies such objects, tells this from what Leir told him, calling Leir "the most knowledgeable ufologist I've ever met."
